text:
NASA FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting ASSET-F01 between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-23 (count: 0). All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period, so the lack of detections isn't due to gaps in coverage.

This doesn't prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected by these sensors (375 m for VIIRS, 1 km for MODIS).

The evidence also doesn't tell us whether there is any burned area, what caused any change on the property (harvest, fire, storm, clearing), or anything outside the evaluated period.

In short, no fire was detected by satellite thermal monitoring, but a small or undetected fire can't be ruled out. This is based on evidence unit EU-FIRE-01 (version 1, current as of 2026-11-12).
